caption: The drawing depicts a rural harvest scene set in a vast, golden wheat field under a partly cloudy sky that takes up the upper portion of the composition. In the foreground and midground, a group of eight men wearing white shirts, light blue pants, and dark hats are positioned in a horizontal line; each man holds a scythe and is actively engaged in cutting down the wheat. Behind and to the right of the men, a group of women, dressed in long skirts or dresses in various shades of blue, brown, and red with white head coverings, are bending or kneeling as they gather and bundle the cut wheat. Numerous bundles of wheat are scattered in rows across the harvested area, and the field stretches into the background where the color transitions from a deep gold to a paler shade near the horizon. The composition is arranged in horizontal layers with the figures aligned in diagonal rows, and no objects other than the wheat, tools, bundles, and people are present. The sky is light blue with numerous large, fluffy white clouds.
title: Harvesting with Grain Cradles
